intro: Journey to the Crossroads directs newly arrived travelers from the elemental plane to the rugged savannah of the Barrens. Adventurers are tasked with reporting to Thork at the Crossroads to assist Horde forces contending with the harsh frontier. It serves as an essential introduction to the mortal perils facing the Horde in Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.
